sections.content: mi? asks the neutral 'what?' about a thing. micsoda? asks the same question with more emphasis or surprise, like English 'what on earth?' Both ask about things, not people — use ki? for people.
sections.title: Asking about things

sections.content: micsoda isn't a different word for 'what' — it's mi with extra emphasis, the way English speakers reach for 'what on earth' instead of plain 'what.'
